configuration.label: v2.7 CONFIRMATION-ONLY acquisition over the frozen 70-repository pool; candidate pool only, no evaluation set, no model, no GPU
configuration.stopping_rule: every repository of the frozen list is processed (max_candidates and min_repositories are unreachable sentinels); at most 30 classified fix commits per repository, newest-first as the runner lists them; independent of outcomes

supersedes_config.reason: r3 reached all 70 repositories but publication was REFUSED (fail-closed): 4 of 5 audit sessions were interrupted (stop, failed start, stop, watchdog-read crash), so protected-access evidence is incomplete. r4 repeats the identical frozen rules in ONE uninterrupted session in a fresh store; only store and report paths differ. Not an outcome-driven change.

label: v2.7 CONFIRMATION-ONLY acquisition over the frozen 70-repository pool; candidate pool only, no evaluation set, no model, no GPU

assumptions: unscanned repositories in the frozen pool pass repository screening at the observed pass fraction
unscanned repositories have the median observed fix-candidate supply since 2025
the pilot admission yield applies to every repository

n400_interpretation.interpretation: a passing corrected confirmation pilot justifies a later 20-30 target native rehearsal; it does not guarantee 400 qualified targets
not_measured: native qualification yield (official tests on both revisions)
N=400 supply is NOT proven by the scanned repositories

native_qualification_workload.note: qualification is NOT performed here; 3 runs x 2 revisions per target

policy.fix_commit_selection: first-parent default-branch commits whose message describes a fix and links a PR/issue (heuristic)

protected_access_evidence.method: sys.addaudithook: every Python-process file open ('open' events) and every subprocess launch ('subprocess.Popen' events: executable, arguments, working directory) is checked against the resolved protected locations; opens performed inside external subprocesses are NOT observed, so subprocess commands and their path arguments are recorded and git's local paths are confined to the store

yield.note: admission yield precedes native qualification (Phase 3); it is an upper bound on the mined-to-qualified yield
